export_policy: Retain response_item visible assistant messages, inbound agent messages, function/custom tool calls and outputs. Exclude system/developer/environment setup, hidden reasoning, session boilerplate and duplicate event wrappers. Native filename denotes filtered source-derived export, not full source session.
transport: Native dispatch receipt plus exact plaintext prompt saved with native apply_patch before dispatch.
limitations: Shared filesystem is not OS isolation. Full native session is retained at original path outside repository, with its SHA-256 provenance. Durable exports contain no privileged harness boilerplate or hidden reasoning.
